title: Tax Form Field Annotation
description: Defines how a single logical annotation document maps taxpayer data onto the printable boxes of one tax form PDF. See docs/SPEC.md for the full specification, grammar and worked examples.

formId.description: Stable identifier for the form, e.g. 'f1040'.

revision.description: Free-text revision/version marker for this annotation pack, e.g. '2025-rev-1'.

sourcePdf.description: Pins this annotation to the exact PDF it was authored against, so a renderer can refuse to run against a form the IRS has silently revised.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the exact PDF file bytes this annotation was authored against.

pageSize.description: Expected page size in points for the pages referenced by this annotation (PDF default letter is 612x792).

coordinateSystem.description: Declares the coordinate convention for every box in this document: units are PDF points (1/72 inch), origin (0,0) is the TOP-LEFT corner of the page, x increases rightward, y increases DOWNWARD. This is the only value this spec version supports; it is still required explicitly so a future version can introduce an alternative without breaking old consumers silently.

box.description: A rectangle on one page of the PDF, in points, measured from the top-left corner of that page.

x.description: Distance from the left edge of the page, in points.

y.description: Distance from the TOP edge of the page, in points.

valueBinding.description: Binds a field to a value in the nested taxpayer data set using the restricted path syntax defined in docs/SPEC.md.

path.description: Restricted JSONPath-lite expression, e.g. '$.income.w2[*].box1Wages'. Must begin with '$'.

aggregate.description: Required when the path resolves to multiple values (i.e. contains a wildcard '[*]' segment). 'join' concatenates with joinSeparator.

joinSeparator.description: Separator used when aggregate is 'join'. Defaults to ', '.

default.description: Value substituted when the path resolves to nothing (missing optional data). If absent and the field is required, a missing resolution is a diagnostic error.

formatSpec.description: Formatting rules applied to the resolved raw value before it is drawn. Which properties are meaningful depends on the field's type (see docs/SPEC.md).

roundingMode.description: IRS whole-dollar rounding is half-up (0.50 rounds away from zero). Only mode supported in v1.

negativeStyle.description: How negative currency/number amounts are displayed. IRS forms conventionally use parentheses, e.g. (1,234).

maskPattern.description: Mask template for 'ssn-mask', using '#' for a digit, e.g. '###-##-####'.

trueText.description: Glyph drawn in a checkbox when the resolved value is truthy.

overflowPolicy.description: Behavior when formatted text does not fit the box width: shrink the font size down to a floor, truncate with an ellipsis, or treat as a hard diagnostic error and skip drawing.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the document, e.g. 'f1040.line1a'.

label.description: Human-readable label copied verbatim from the form (not a tax explanation), e.g. 'Total amount from Form(s) W-2, box 1'.

minFontSize.description: Floor used by the 'shrink' overflow policy.

options.description: For type 'radio-group' only: the set of mutually exclusive options, exactly one of which may be selected.

matchValue.description: The resolved value that selects this option (string/boolean/number equality).

axis.description: For type 'table' only: whether repeating instances lay out downward (rows) or sideways (columns, e.g. the 1040 dependents table).

itemsPath.description: For type 'table' only: a path (same restricted syntax, no trailing [*] required) selecting the repeating array in the taxpayer data, e.g. '$.dependents'.

maxInstances.description: For type 'table' only: number of physical slots printed on the form. Extra data instances beyond this are reported as an overflow diagnostic, never silently dropped.

pitch.description: For type 'table' only: the fixed offset from one instance's origin to the next, added (instanceIndex) times to every sub-field box.

columns.description: For type 'table' only: sub-field templates, one per column/row of data, positioned relative to instance 0 and repeated via 'pitch' for each subsequent instance.
